items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Not Bob Lyon. Bob Lyon played bass violin.

ctx.x: You must have had a tuba player.
Yeah, but I'm going to tell you. Franky Dusen on trombone. And I can't call this name, but he used to hang at Ramport and Petita all the time. Not Bob Lyon. Bob Lyon played bass violin.
